visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a black beanie and a dark green knit sweater with a geometric pattern, stands on a city sidewalk. The background features bright yellow ginkgo trees and urban storefronts. He looks directly at the camera, placing a finger to his lips in a hushing gesture before looking upward. (2) He transitions into a rhythmic performance, touching his chest and then his forehead in a stylized salute as he begins to walk forward. The camera follows him in a handheld motion, capturing pedestrians in the background under a soft, overcast daylight. (3) He continues walking down the sidewalk, gesturing towards his face and the surrounding environment with fluid hand motions. The camera maintains a medium full shot, showing his rhythmic gait and the bustling street scene of what appears to be a Japanese shopping district with various retail signs and cyclists passing by.
